timeline.text: One video repeated the same animated effect five times in a row, even though I kept telling it to vary things.
The system had no memory — every clip, it reached for its favorite effect again, same day or the next.
Now a Postgres column records exactly which effect played in which video.
The code checks that history before picking, and enforces a hard cap no prompt could guarantee.
No effect can repeat more than three times in one video now.
